citations.text: Barzilai, S., & Chinn, C. A. (2024). The AIR and Apt-AIR frameworks of epistemic performance and growth: Reflections on educational theory development. Educational Psychology Review, 36(3), 91.

en.general: A goal of building a representation of the world, such as a model, explanation, theory or belief, that one tries to get right. How much a person values the aim affects how hard they work to reach it.

examples: Wanting to understand why a population changed over time and building a model that explains it.
Wanting a true answer about a health claim and spending time to check it.
nonExamples: A task goal such as finishing a worksheet, unless the goal is about getting something right about the world.
